## HirePulse → Firecrawl | review candidate
Manual preview: 50 synthetic records, no credentials or calls. Set `maxScrapes:20` to reproduce the 50→20 scenario. For live mode add two HTTP Header Auth credentials, set your budgets and replace the domain list. Review both output branches.

## Alexandria extension
Select a documented firmographic provider with Firecrawl after validating access, fields, credit cost and data terms. Keep the extension off the execution path for v1. [Alexandria docs](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/alexandria).
